## change

describe the bounded behavior and requirement IDs.

## evidence

- [ ] behavior-level test added or updated
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes
- [ ] public schema, examples, and docs updated when needed
- [ ] package contents checked when exports changed

## boundaries

- [ ] deterministic and model-assisted evidence remain separate
- [ ] privacy and network behavior are unchanged or explicitly documented
- [ ] no policy mutation or publication path was added
- [ ] architecture policy passes without a new exception

## human check

name any positioning-owner, writer, security, or OSS check that still needs a person.
